title: Rio Tinto releases second quarter 2026 production results
excerpt: Rio Tinto reported a 3% year-over-year increase in first-half copper-equivalent production, 31% growth at Oyu Tolgoi, Q2 consolidated copper production of 213 kt down 7% year over year and sequentially, and unchanged 2026 copper guidance of 800-870 kt.
summary: The issuer production release supplies current operating evidence for Rio Tinto's diversified commodity exposure, Oyu Tolgoi ramp, copper costs, quarterly copper output, and unchanged production guidance.
